question: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.
sql:
-- Final query: distinct player names who scored >= 100 runs in a match while playing for the losing team
WITH player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.striker AS player_id,
        b.match_id,
        SUM(CAST(bs.runs_scored AS INTEGER)) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs 
      ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
      AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
      AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
      AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    p.player_name
FROM player_match_runs pmr
JOIN player_match pm ON pmr.player_id = pm.player_id AND pmr.match_id = pm.match_id
JOIN match m ON pmr.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON pmr.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE pmr.total_runs >= 100
  AND pm.team_id != m.match_winner
ORDER BY p.player_name

    JOIN batsman_scored bs 
      ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
      AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
      AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
      AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    COUNT(*) AS instances
FROM player_match_runs pmr
JOIN player_match pm ON pmr.player_id = pm.player_id AND pmr.match_id = pm.match_id
JOIN match m ON pmr.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON pmr.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE pmr.total_runs >= 100
  AND pm.team_id != m.match_winner
GROUP BY p.player_name
ORDER BY p.player_name
